description.name: Extended Renzokuken

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking

description.name: Revived Lion's Soul
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] and Red Aura +1 to the user when the user's HP fall below 20%, removed after triggering

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
